## Summary

Describe the problem and the proposed change.

## Type of contribution

- [ ] Documentation
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature or controller capability
- [ ] Hardware or driver compatibility
- [ ] Experiment, dataset, or analysis
- [ ] Refactoring or maintenance

## Validation

Explain how the change was tested. Include commands, hardware details, logs, plots, or sample output where relevant.

## Reproducibility

- [ ] Hardware and operating-system details are documented.
- [ ] Dependency and driver versions are documented.
- [ ] Configuration changes are included or explained.
- [ ] Commands and expected results are provided.
- [ ] Sensitive information has been removed from logs.
- [ ] Documentation was updated where behavior or setup changed.

## Compatibility and limitations

Describe known limitations, untested configurations, and possible breaking changes.

## Related issue

Link the issue this pull request addresses, for example: `Closes #123`.
